title: Omoluabi News Evidence Source
description: One entry in _data/evidence.json's `sources` array — the evidence format the reasoning engine (_js/reasoning-engine.js) consumes directly. Distinct from schemas/evidence.schema.json, which is the research-pipeline Evidence Card format written by tools/*.py into data/processed/ before a human promotes reviewed material here by hand.

type.description: Must match a key in _js/reasoning-engine.js's SOURCE_LADDER.
